title: Wind
paragraphs: And so my father explained the situation to the queen. It was a typical explanation from him—full of sarcasm.
“Uh, uh-huh… I am Queen Mirellia Q Melromarc of the Kingdom of Melromarc. I’m sorry it took me so long to come to your aid.”
“Well… it was a farce from the start anyway. So… were you saying that if I met with you, this whole mess would somehow be resolved?”
“Truly… everything that happened this time is entirely my fault.”
“Mother…”
Just as they were having this exchange, the Crimson Swine was hiding behind me, oinking away.
“Malty… I have a lot… a looooot to say to you once we get back to the castle, so brace yourself.”
“Oink-oink!”
“Silence that fool.”
“Yes, ma’am!”
With that, one of the Queen’s soldiers tied up the Crimson Swine and hauled it away. Serves him right!

“Um… Spear Hero, I am Myne… Malty’s mother. I merely used my authority to order you to accompany me back to the castle. Now then, Heroes, this battle is over. Let’s take a break and return to Melromarc Castle.”
“It seems there’s some explanation for this. Understood.”
I’d love to just whoosh through a portal to the castle. Oh, my Father isn’t using his Curse Skill, so he’s doing just fine! That’s a relief!
“The Shield Hero, Naofumi Iwatani, will be joining us as well. Let’s chat on the way.”
“I see… but what is this? This feeling of deflation.”
“Uh…”
The Queen seems at a loss for words. Oh? The Shadow Pig has appeared and is saying something to the Queen.
“The other Heroes… Oh?”
When I look back, Ren, Itsuki, Fleon-chan, and Black Thunder are all gone. When did they vanish? Is it a concealment skill? Should I try to flush them out?
“Leave them be. They’ll surely show up somewhere pretending to be ordinary people. That’s definitely the direction they’re heading.”
“Is that so?”
“I’m sure of it.”
“Naofumi, you seem to know quite a bit about that sort of thing.”
“I don’t know the details, but considering how they act, it seems likely.”
“Hmm… Anyway, as long as this proves Lord Naofumi’s innocence, that’s fine.”

And so, with that settled, we decided to return to the castle. By the way, the Lazy Pig and the Crimson Swine’s companions were taken away together. Since we didn’t have to tend to Father’s injuries or anything like that, we were able to return to the castle in less than three days.

Anyway, it seemed like the Queen and Father were having a conversation. She was probably explaining the circumstances and what had happened so far to him. They were also discussing the punishment for Crimson Swine and Trash. Oh, and on the way back, Itsuki took off his mask as if it were the most natural thing in the world and joined us.
“Well, Naofumi-san, it seems we’ve weathered the crisis… We’d been on alert, sensing something was up with this commotion, but I’m sorry we couldn’t make it to the scene in time.”
“Bueh…”
“…Is that your policy? What happened to the ‘Vice-General’ approach of hiding and upholding justice?”

“Justice must be demonstrated. Hiding makes no sense at all. That said, the title ‘Bow Hero’ is too grand… Yes, just like the Saint of the Divine Bird, the Filolial Mask, and Perfect Justice—by letting people know that there are those who watch over evil even if they aren’t heroes, they can live righteously.”

That’s what Itsuki said. That’s quite a different philosophy from the first world, isn’t it? Still, it doesn’t seem to be causing much harm, so let’s just leave it be. I’m sure Fleon-chan will figure something out.
“Justice~ Cutting Through the Wind~ Justice Will~ Protect You~”
“Ah, aaaah… Many heroes are upholding justice with various beliefs in their hearts. That’s what I mean.”
After what seemed like a moment of inner turmoil, Itsuki finished his explanation. Father gave Fleon-chan a disapproving look, then said to Itsuki,
“Is that really what you call ‘perfect justice’? Itsuki… aren’t you being brainwashed by that guy over there?”
“It’s a matter of musical compatibility. Those who were once under my command were evil hidden within justice, and our musical styles just stopped meshing.”
“…I see.”
I feel like my Father is looking at Itsuki with sympathy… but I’m probably just imagining things.
“Um…”
Fleon-chan, who’s accompanying Itsuki and has taken off her mask to reveal her angelic form, walks over toward us and heads to where Filo-tan, my Finacée, my Father, and my Big Sister are standing.
“Hello. My name is Fleon. It’s a pleasure to meet you all.”
“Um… I’m Melty Melromarc.”
“Filo’s name is Filo!”
My Finacée steps forward to introduce herself.
“You look just like Filo-chan. How do you do?”
My Finacée lifts her skirt slightly and gives a regal-style curtsy.
“Are you a Filolial too, Fleon?”
“Yes, I’m a Filolial as well.”
With a soft “whoosh…” Fleon-chan flutters her wings slightly and floats into the air.
“Wow… she’s flying in the sky—how cool!”
“That’s amazing!”
My Finacée’s eyes are sparkling as she watches Fleon-chan floating there.
“Hehehe.”
Fleon-chan smiles as she takes in the gazes of her Finacée and Filo-tan.
“Hmm…”

Ah! Filo-tan is feeling a bit of jealousy—no, actually, she’s getting jealous that her Finacée’s attention is focused on Fleon-chan! Eek! Filo-tan! You mustn’t do that! Fleon-chan! Please, you absolutely must not take my finacée away from Filo-tan!
“Ha, ha, ha… My finacée, Princess Melty. If you get too friendly with Fleon-chan, Filo-tan—who’s right here beside me—will get jealous.”
“Huh? Oh…”
“Boo…”
“Filo-chan, don’t be mad. Fleon-san will definitely become your friend too, so let’s all get along.”
My Finacée is desperately trying to soothe Filo-tan. Come on, Finacée! Use that “fate power” of yours—the ability to become friends with Filo-tan no matter who you meet—to take care of her!
“Here, I’ll give you a treat, so be nice to each other, okay?”
I hand out the jerky I carry with me to my Finacée and Filo-tan. Of course, I give some to Fleon-chan, too.
“You’re giving this to Filo? Yay!”
“Here I go.”
Filo-tan and Fleon-chan have started eating the jerky I handed them, getting along just fine.
“Don’t just gobble up something you got from Motoyasu!”
Father is scolding her, but Filo-tan just keeps eating.
"Huh? It's fine, Master—it's not poisonous, right?"
"Seriously…"
Just then, my Finacée—who’s been holding a piece of jerky without eating it—speaks up to Fleon-chan.
"Fleon, are you by any chance one of those flying Filolials that are said to be extinct?"
“I’ve heard that’s the case… though even I, Fleon, don’t know any more than that about my origins. It’s a mystery within a mystery.”
“A mystery within a mystery… You’re just making it a mystery on your own. And speaking of which, the name ‘Fleon’…”
My future father turns his gaze toward me. We’re not in a position to talk about this yet.
“That’s the name the Spear Hero shouted excitedly when he saw Filo, right?”
“It does look a lot like Filo, actually.”
“Does it?”
“Hmm?”
It’s an adorable scene with Fleon-chan and Filo-tan both tilting their little heads.
“Earlier, during the battle against the Pope of the Three Heroes Church, it was you, Fleon, who helped us, right?”
“No! I’m not some hero called ‘Filolial Mask No. 2’!”

Fleon-chan spreads her wings wide with a flourish and strikes a pose, denying her Finacée’s question. She must really like the masked hero thing. She seems to get along well with Itsuki, so there’s no doubt about it.
“So please understand that I am definitely not the true identity of Filolial Mask No. 2!”
“…I suppose this is what they mean by ‘giving yourself away.’ Even though Melty never even mentioned Filolial Mask No. 2…”
Her father-in-law and Big Sister let out sighs.
“So there really was a hero like that. I can’t let myself be outdone, then.”
Itsuki nods repeatedly, reading his lines flatly. Her father-in-law’s face turns displeased.
“What a bunch of phony people… It looks like even hanging out with them would be exhausting…”
Eventually, as if completely deflated, my Father just cut the conversation short.
“So Mr. Fleon isn’t Filolial Mask No. 2… O-okay, I get it.”
My Finacée also nodded in agreement, swept up by Fleon-chan’s enthusiasm.
“Hmm?”
It was a memorable exchange, with Filo-tan tilting her little head. So, it’s time to meet up with Itsuki.
“Itsuki, do you know where Ren is?”
“I think Ren is probably nearby. Look.”
With that, Itsuki pointed to Ren, who was riding on Black Thunder’s back in a tree a short distance away.
“Hmph… So you noticed after all.”
“Ah… So that’s where you were. What was that black guy riding a pointlessly huge, black Filolial doing up in that tree?”
“I was… reading the wind. Let’s move on.”
“There’s no sign of darkness. No need to linger here.”
Black Thunder, with Ren on its back, leaped down from the tree and began walking.
“…Seriously, what is it with these guys?”

My father furrowed his brow as he watched Ren and Itsuki. It wasn’t exactly “effortless,” though. The moment he took his eyes off them, Ren and Black Thunder vanished, so the queens had a hard time calling them back.

When my Father spoke as if casting a spell to summon Ren—saying, “Can the darkness of this land simply depart without receiving its just punishment?”—it seems he obediently followed along. My father really knows how to handle Ren and Black Thunder, doesn’t he?

And so, after reuniting with the queen, we were escorted to the castle of Melromarc. Inside the castle, my father and the queen led the way, with us following behind. It brings back memories. Even though we’ve been through a lot of loops, there’s still a sense of nostalgia.
“Oh! Malty and Marti! Well done on defeating the Shield and returning safely. By the way, why is Marti bound and gagged?”

That predictable Trash said this with an expression that seemed relieved that his Finacée and the Crimson Swine were safe. What was I thinking at that moment? I feel like I was just blissfully relieved that everything was over and the incident had been resolved. Well, I do recall being a little worried about Crimson Swine. Looking back now, that worry was completely unnecessary.
“It’s because he’s noisy when he talks. Should we just sew his mouth shut while we’re at it?”
The Queen said this while casting a contemptuous glance at Crimson Swine. Then she turned and confronted Trash.
“Why is that wretch here! Execute him immediately!”
“I won’t let you!”
Well, this exchange was a scene I’d seen in the first world.
“Evil has been punished, hasn’t it?”
Just as Trash was being struck with a fan by the Queen, Fleon-chan said proudly, chest puffed out.
“The pus is being removed. This is what truth is all about.”
“That’s the truth.”
Black Thunder and Ren are also watching Trash with cold, detached eyes.
“Well then, I’d like to introduce myself properly. I am Mirellia Q Melromarc, Queen of the Kingdom of Melromarc. It’s a pleasure to meet you all.”
The queen declared this as she looked at me, Ren, and Itsuki. It really drove home who was in charge in this kingdom.
“Nice to meet you.”
“Hmph… The triumphant return of the true queen, I see.”
“So the false ruler has been overthrown by justice, has she not?”
Rin and Itsuki’s lines are a bit different from the first world, but it’s generally fine.
“I propose that I ask the heroes to spare me a little of their time starting today.”
“Understood.”
“We don’t have time to take it easy.”
“True… We don’t know where the stray darkness might be trying to disrupt the harmony.”
I got the impression the Queen looked a bit flustered by Itsuki and Ren’s remarks.
“Um… I would be grateful if you could at least join us for the banquet. We’ll have a meaningful discussion then. All heroes except Lord Iwatani, please relax in your guest rooms.”
“Hmph… If you put it that way, I suppose I have no choice. If we don’t conserve our strength, it’ll be difficult to send the darkness back to the darkness.”
“Discussions are important. Understood.”
“Roger that!”

Worried about Crimson Swine? You must be joking! After this, Crimson Swine will be judged right in front of his Father, and after all sorts of things happen, he’ll come crying to me. Whether he’ll actually cry… that’ll be a sight to see. After all, I’ve been scheming behind the scenes for this very reason. Ah… that’s right.
“Your Majesty, may I make a suggestion here?”
“What is it? At the very least, I cannot permit even the Spear Hero to interfere with Malty’s punishment.”
“That’s completely irrelevant.”
“Oink!?”
“That’s…”
The Queen seems taken aback, but I don’t really care. Did I misread her reaction? Well, never mind.
“Would it be all right if I brought an acquaintance along to dinner?”
